quests.title: The Emergence of Irate Fish?

dialogue.t: Miss Guillotin mentioned you've been running an aquarium. Naturally, I accepted her invitation to come serve as a marine consultant!

dialogue.sit: Happy to have you on board!
We're so glad for the extra help!

dialogue.t: Great! With Head Nurse Sigewinne around, we won't have to worry about the little fishies getting sick!
Hehe, since you asked me to look after the animals at the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland, I've picked up a few tricks of the trade...
It turns out looking after animals isn't all that different from caring for patients. Well, the well-behaved ones, at least.
But that's the thing — not all fish are well-behaved. So, on top of looking after the ones you already have, I have a few ideas for inpatient therapy that I'd like to discuss.

dialogue.sit: Please, go ahead. I'm all ears.

dialogue.t: The word from Officer Ceasth is that certain wild fish have been getting unusually aggressive lately. Apparently, they're attacking other creatures, as well as divers and even small boats.
I was wondering if we could invite them to the aquarium for some rest and relaxation? At the very least, it'll keep them from causing any more trouble.
Once they're here, I can look for a way to cure their sudden bad temper.
That way, we can help the fish and the waters return to normal, and you can add some unique guest performers to your aquarium.
Alright, I'll give you all the intel I have on where to find those aggressive fish. The rest is up to you!

quests.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us…
